summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(str(self))); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when ref equals a stored term URI under node-type-aware equality, inherited by _RDFNamespace. Changed ClosedNamespace._ipython_key_completions_ to dir(str(self.uri)). Added NamespaceMembershipTest in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self, SH, RDFS closed (positive, shared-base negative, plain string and Literal negatives), RDF closed positive, and rdf:_1 container negative. Nothing was committed. Tests and doctests were not run, because the instructions ruled out running repository code; the changes were checked by reading only.
